- If departure is delayed at least 5 hours, you may choose not to travel and request reimbursement of the unused ticket instead.
- Business class does not increase the statutory compensation; the amounts are per passenger, not based on fare class.
- Under U.S. rules, ordinary delays do not generally trigger mandatory cash compensation. If the flight is cancelled or significantly changed and you reject the alternative, you are generally entitled to a refund.
